criteria.yes: It agrees to exactly what the assistant asked, with nothing added, changed or conditional. A short agreement such as okay, sure, mm-hmm or please do counts.
criteria.no: It declines what the assistant asked, or takes it back.
criteria.question: It asks the assistant something, or asks about what was proposed, instead of answering.
criteria.other: It agrees but changes the project, thread or terms, adds a condition, or names something else.
criteria.unrelated: It does not answer what the assistant asked.
